Writing Python script to verify the infobox values for Moon (specifically minimum perigee or perigee) and calculate the result.
```python
# Let's inspect all perigee or orbital parameters in Moon infobox and text from Wikipedia.
cmd = '''python -c "
import urllib.request
import json

url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=parse&page=Moon&prop=wikitext&format=json'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
res = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
data = json.loads(res.read().decode('utf-8'))
wt = data['parse']['wikitext']['*']

# Print lines with perigee or perighelion or distance
for line in wt.splitlines():
    if 'perigee' in line.lower() or 'closest' in line.lower() or 'perigee_km' in line.lower():
        print(line)
"'''
res_moon = await run_command(cmd)
print(res_moon)
```
